articles.summary: Reports First Profitable Fourth Quarter Since Fiscal 2021, Strong Start to Fiscal 2026 IRVINE, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mar. 11, 2026-- Tilly’s, Inc. (NYSE: TLYS, the "Company") today announced financial results for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025 ended January 31, 2026.
articles.title: Tilly's, Inc. Fiscal 2025 Fourth Quarter Results Exceed Expectations
